resources.string: 1. Open “Phone & TV” on your TV and choose “Pair phone”.\n2. Scan the QR code here.\n3. Confirm the comparison code on both devices.

Transfers appearance, language, playback preferences and menu sounds. Accounts, sources and sign-ins stay unchanged.
Choose the accounts and network sources to add or update on the receiving device.
Keep Ambient TV open on both devices. Confirm the import on the TV.
WireGuard is selected. Do not use the same VPN key on both devices at the same time.

Without sign-ins or passwords. Spotify and SmartTube sign-ins and IPTV access require this option.
